article_content: Typically, Germany and France are strong allies in Europe, but recent U.S. diplomatic communications reveal a significant rift between them over satellite technology. German space and intelligence agencies have accused France of acting in bad faith and are now looking to the United States as a potential partner for developing next-generation satellites. The core of this disagreement is HiRos, a High Resolution Optical System that promises significant advancements in satellite surveillance. Cables obtained by WikiLeaks and published by the Norwegian newspaper Aftenposten show German officials advocating for a 'strategic US/German partnership' in 2009 to develop HiRos, despite French efforts to halt the project. The cables highlight the political strategies and technological potential of HiRos, along with the German space agency's (DLR) determination to launch it by 2013. The DLR is eager to reduce Germany's reliance on foreign imagery sources. German officials were cautious about the dual use of HiRos for intelligence and commercial purposes. In February 2009, U.S. diplomats were informed that the program would be managed by a civilian agency to minimize political backlash. However, a later cable from September 2009 identified the German intelligence service as the primary customer for HiRos. One cable from February 2009 reveals German efforts to shift HiRos development away from a Franco-German consortium towards a German company, aiming to reduce French interference. A senior DLR official stated that Germany had been cornered by France and had little choice but to proceed independently within the EU. Another official explained that a U.S. alliance would prevent a French monopoly in the lucrative electro-optical imagery market but expressed concern over France's aggressive lobbying against HiRos. German officials, while lobbying the U.S. embassy in Berlin, emphasized that HiRos would make Germany a more valuable partner by offering unique capabilities. A senior German official proposed deploying three German and three U.S. satellites, sharing the imagery. Access to U.S. imagery of regions like China, North Korea, Iran, and the Haqqani Network would also benefit Germany's intelligence gathering. U.S. diplomats praised the German satellite program, highlighting HiRos' daily revisit capability and its ability to provide detailed 3D images. German officials assured that HiRos could process data in near real-time, significantly faster than current systems. Despite intense lobbying, HiRos remains in the project phase. CNN has contacted the German space agency for updates on HiRos' status and funding. Neither the U.S. State Department nor the French Foreign Ministry commented on the leaked cables, citing policies against discussing classified information.
translated_content: Biasanya, Jerman dan Perancis adalah sekutu yang kuat di Eropah, tetapi komunikasi diplomatik Amerika Syarikat baru-baru ini mendedahkan perpecahan besar antara mereka berdua mengenai teknologi satelit. Agensi angkasa lepas dan perisikan Jerman telah menuduh Perancis bertindak dengan niat jahat dan kini melihat Amerika Syarikat sebagai rakan kongsi potensi untuk membangunkan satelit generasi seterusnya. Inti pertelingkahan ini adalah HiRos, satu Sistem Optik Resolusi Tinggi yang menjanjikan peningkatan besar dalam pengawasan satelit. Kabel yang diperoleh oleh WikiLeaks dan diterbitkan oleh akhbar Norway Aftenposten menunjukkan pegawai Jerman mengusulkan 'kerjasama strategik AS/Jerman' pada tahun 2009 untuk membangunkan HiRos, walaupun usaha Perancis untuk menghentikan projek itu. Kabel-kabel itu menonjolkan strategi politik dan potensi teknologi HiRos, serta keazaman agensi angkasa lepas Jerman (DLR) untuk melancarkannya pada tahun 2013. DLR ingin mengurangkan kebergantungan Jerman terhadap sumber imej asing. Pegawai Jerman berhati-hati tentang penggunaan berganda HiRos untuk tujuan perisikan dan komersial. Pada Februari 2009, diplomat Amerika diberitahu bahawa program itu akan diuruskan oleh agensi awam untuk mengurangkan tamparan politik. Namun, kabel kemudian dari September 2009 mengenal pasti perkhidmatan perisikan Jerman sebagai pelanggan utama HiRos. Satu kabel dari Februari 2009 mendedahkan usaha Jerman untuk mengalihkan pembangunan HiRos daripada konsortium Perancis-Jerman kepada syarikat Jerman, berusaha mengurangkan campur tangan Perancis. Seorang pegawai kanan DLR menyatakan bahawa Jerman telah disudutkan oleh Perancis dan tidak mempunyai pilihan lain selain bertindak secara bebas dalam EU. Pegawai lain menjelaskan bahawa perikatan dengan Amerika Syarikat akan mencegah monopoli Perancis dalam pasaran imej elektro-optik yang menguntungkan, tetapi mengalu-alukan lobian agresif Perancis menentang HiRos. Pegawai Jerman, semasa melobikan Kedutaan Amerika di Berlin, menekankan bahawa HiRos akan menjadikan Jerman sebagai rakan kongsi yang lebih berharga dengan memberikan keupayaan unik. Seorang pegawai kanan Jerman mencadangkan penempatan tiga satelit Jerman dan tiga satelit Amerika, berkongsi imej. Akses ke imej Amerika di kawasan seperti China, Korea Utara, Iran, dan Rangkaian Haqqani juga akan membantu pengumpulan risikan Jerman. Diplomat Amerika memuji program satelit Jerman, menonjolkan keupayaan lawatan harian HiRos dan kebolehannya untuk memberikan imej 3D yang terperinci. Pegawai Jerman menjamin bahawa HiRos boleh memproses data dalam masa nyata atau 'milisaat', jauh lebih cepat daripada sistem semasa. Walaupun lobian yang giat, HiRos kekal dalam fasa projek. CNN telah menghubungi agensi angkasa lepas Jerman untuk kemas kini mengenai status dan pembiayaan HiRos. Tiada Jabatan Negara Amerika Syarikat mahupun Kementerian Luar Perancis mengulas mengenai kabel yang bocor, dengan menyatakan dasar tidak membincangkan maklumat sulit.

article_content: Peter Boyd, an attorney and the founder of PaperStreet, has assisted over 1,500 law firms with their web presence and marketing strategies. For attorneys, our reputations are hard-won and precious. We invest countless hours in excelling at law school and endure demanding workloads during our studies and early practice years. Then, a negative online review strikes, threatening our hard-earned status. However, a single bad review doesn't have to ruin your law firm's reputation. While it can be discouraging and potentially harmful, remember that one negative incident doesn't define your entire professional journey. There are steps to maintain a positive online image and mitigate any negative feedback. Respond Quickly to Negative Online Comments When dealing with negative publicity, such as reviews or comments, quick action is crucial to limit potential damage. A prompt response shows transparency, accountability, and a commitment to resolving the issue. By addressing concerns immediately, offering clear explanations or apologies where needed, and engaging with the public, you can regain trust and reduce the impact of a negative review. Depending on where the negative review is posted, you can take various actions. For instance, if a reviewer's claim is false, you can politely discredit it in your response and report it to the review management company. Similarly, ask colleagues to flag the review as spam. In my experience, platforms like Google and Facebook may not remove reviews as quickly as desired, but taking swift action is better than doing nothing if the review is fake or unfounded. If the negative feedback has merit, consider posting a conciliatory response and offering to discuss further with the client. Don't Let Fear Prevent You From Seeking Feedback Although negative reviews can be problematic, client feedback is essential for reputation management. Consistently gathering reviews and building a positive online presence is vital. Proactively collecting positive reviews can overshadow any negative feedback. Here are some effective ways to obtain client reviews: Request reviews during phone calls or in-person meetings, expressing gratitude for their business and kindly asking for feedback. Send follow-up emails after providing service to gather valuable testimonials. Use an email campaign targeting past clients, inviting them to share their experiences. Provide clients with an exit pamphlet as their case concludes, offering helpful resources and reminding them to leave a review. Prioritize reviews on your Google Business Profile, as it is the primary platform where web users find your firm. Once you have at least five reviews on Google, expand to other platforms like Facebook, Yelp, or Avvo. Spreading testimonials across various platforms showcases a positive reputation, but focusing on one platform initially helps establish a strong foundation. Reviews also impact your SEO efforts, improving your firm's search result ranking. More positive reviews enhance your Google Local Service Ads (LSAs) performance, appearing at the top of search results and charged only when clicked. Create a Results Page for Your Website After handling a few cases, create a dedicated results page to showcase your expertise and success. Share case descriptions and outcomes, incorporating reviews from various platforms, video testimonials, or quotes from satisfied clients. Compiling this information provides prospective clients with evidence of your firm's excellent reputation and positive client experiences. If sharing case results isn't possible, a 'representative transactions' page can also be useful. Some clients may allow you to share their names, but even without names, detailing case resolutions demonstrates your success. Including written or video testimonials adds a personal touch and credibility. Ultimately, your online reputation significantly influences how potential clients perceive your law firm. Many lawyers avoid the spotlight to prevent negative reviews, but this fear can hinder your firm's growth. Building a positive online presence through social media, solicited reviews, and a strong website can help overcome the impact of a few negative reviews. If your only online review is negative, your firm's reputation will suffer. However, preparing for inevitable negative feedback can turn it into a minor issue rather than a defining moment.
translated_content: Peter Boyd, seorang peguam dan pengasas PaperStreet, telah membantu lebih dari 1,500 firma guaman dengan kehadiran web dan strategi pemasaran mereka. Bagi peguam, reputasi kami adalah berharga dan susah didapati. Kami melabur berjam-jam untuk bersaing di sekolah undang-undang dan menangani beban kerja yang mencabar semasa belajar dan tahun-tahun awal amalan. Kemudian, ulasan dalam talian yang negatif menghantui, mengancam status yang susah didapati. Walau bagaimanapun, satu ulasan buruk tidak perlu merosakkan reputasi firma guaman anda. Walaupun ia boleh menyedihkan dan berpotensi merosakkan, ingatlah bahawa satu insiden negatif tidak mendefinisikan seluruh perjalanan profesional anda. Terdapat langkah-langkah untuk mengekalkan imej dalam talian yang positif dan mengurangkan sebarang maklum balas negatif. Bertindak dengan Cepat terhadap Ulasan Dalam Talian yang Negatif Apabila menghadapi publisiti negatif, seperti ulasan atau komen, tindakan cepat adalah penting untuk meminimumkan kerosakan yang mungkin berlaku. Respon pantas menunjukkan ketelusan, pertanggungjawaban dan komitmen untuk menyelesaikan isu tersebut. Dengan menangani kebimbangan segera, memberikan penjelasan atau permohonan maaf di mana perlu, dan berinteraksi dengan orang ramai, anda boleh memulihkan kepercayaan dan mengurangkan kesan ulasan negatif. Bergantung kepada di mana ulasan negatif diposkan, anda boleh mengambil pelbagai tindakan. Sebagai contoh, jika tuntutan pengulas adalah palsu, anda boleh membantahnya dengan sopan dalam respons anda dan melaporkannya kepada syarikat yang menguruskan ulasan. Sama juga, minta rakan sekerja untuk menandakan ulasan sebagai spam. Dalam pengalaman saya, platform seperti Google dan Facebook mungkin tidak menghapuskan ulasan dengan cepat seperti yang diinginkan oleh banyak peguam, tetapi tindakan cepat oleh anda lebih baik daripada tidak melakukan apa-apa jika ulasan atau komen adalah palsu atau tidak berasas. Jika maklum balas negatif mempunyai kaitan, pertimbangkan untuk memposkan respons penyelesaian dan menawarkan untuk berbincang lebih lanjut dengan klien. Jangan Biarkan Ketakutan Mencegah Anda Daripada Meminta Maklum Balas Walaupun ulasan negatif boleh menjadi masalah, maklum balas klien adalah penting untuk pengurusan reputasi. Secara konsisten mengumpul ulasan dan membina kehadiran dalam talian yang positif adalah penting. Secara proaktif mengumpul ulasan positif boleh menghalang sebarang maklum balas negatif. Berikut adalah beberapa cara yang berkesan untuk mendapatkan ulasan klien: Minta ulasan semasa panggilan telefon atau mesyuarat secara langsung, menyatakan terima kasih atas perniagaan mereka dan meminta maklum balas dengan sopan. Hantar e-mel susulan selepas menyediakan perkhidmatan untuk mengumpul keterangan berharga. Gunakan kempen e-mel yang menargetkan klien lama, mengajak mereka untuk berkongsi pengalaman mereka. Berikan kepada klien risalah keluar semasa kes mereka tamat, menyediakan sumber yang berguna serta pengingat untuk meninggalkan ulasan. Tumpukan ulasan pada Profil Perniagaan Google anda, kerana ia adalah platform utama di mana pengguna web mencari firma anda. Sekiranya anda mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya lima ulasan di Google, perluaskan usaha anda untuk mengumpul ulasan di platform lain seperti Facebook, Yelp atau Avvo. Menyebarkan keterangan di pelbagai platform menunjukkan reputasi positif, tetapi menumpukan pada satu platform pada mulanya membantu menubuhkan asas yang kukuh. Ulasan juga memberi kesan kepada usaha SEO anda, meningkatkan kedudukan firma anda dalam keputusan carian. Lebih banyak ulasan positif meningkatkan prestasi Iklan Perkhidmatan Tempatan Google (LSAs) anda, muncul di bahagian atas halaman keputusan enjin carian dan dicaj hanya apabila seseorang mengklik iklan anda. Buat Halaman Keputusan untuk Laman Web Anda Selepas menangani beberapa kes, buat halaman keputusan yang khusus untuk memperlihatkan kepakaran dan kejayaan anda. Berkongsi penerangan kes serta keputusannya, menggabungkan ulasan dari pelbagai platform, video keterangan atau petikan dari e-mel daripada klien yang berpuas hati. Dengan mengumpul maklumat ini, anda memberikan klien potensi dengan bukti yang menarik tentang reputasi firma anda yang cemerlang dan pengalaman positif klien lain dengan bekerja bersama anda. Jika tidak dapat memberikan keputusan kes, halaman 'transaksi perwakilan' juga boleh berguna. Beberapa klien mungkin membenarkan anda berkongsi nama mereka, tetapi walaupun tanpa nama, menerangkan penyelesaian kes anda masih boleh menunjukkan kejayaan anda. Menyertakan keterangan bertulis atau video menambah sentuhan peribadi dan kebolehpercayaan. Akhir kata, reputasi dalam talian anda mempengaruhi secara ketara bagaimana klien potensi melihat firma guaman anda. Banyak peguam menghindari sorotan untuk mengelakkan ulasan negatif, tetapi ketakutan ini boleh menghalang pertumbuhan firma anda. Membina kehadiran dalam talian yang positif melalui media sosial, ulasan yang diminta dan laman web yang kuat boleh membantu mengatasi kesan beberapa ulasan negatif. Jika anda hanya mempunyai satu ulasan dalam talian dan ia negatif, reputasi firma anda akan menderita. Walau bagaimanapun, bersedia untuk maklum balas negatif yang tidak dapat dielakkan boleh menjadikannya isu kecil berbanding momen penentu.

article_content: By Rachel Reilly. PUBLISHED: 12:00 EST, 20 June 2013 | UPDATED: 12:00 EST, 20 June 2013 Probiotic supplements help to boost Vitamin D levels, according to new research. A study found that taking a probiotic supplement boosted levels of the vitamin by more than 25 percent. It is the first evidence that probiotics play a role in maintaining levels of the bone-strengthening nutrient. Taking a probiotic supplement boosts a person's levels of Vitamin D - the sunshine vitamin - by more than 25 percent. Previous studies have shown the effect of the particular strain of a probiotic, called Lactobacillus reuteri NCIMB 30242, on cholesterol reduction, but its effect on the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins such as Vitamin D was unknown. Researchers investigated the effects of the probiotics after a supplement had been taken by a group of adults for nine weeks. They tested levels of Vitamin D by monitoring levels of 25-hydroxyvitamin D in the blood. Vitamin D levels are of increasing concern as the numbers of children developing rickets, and the number of adults developing osteoporosis, increases. Insufficient Vitamin D contributes to these conditions by reducing calcium absorption, and by in turn weakening the bones. Researchers are also beginning to discover links between Vitamin D levels and protection against heart disease, autoimmune diseases, and diabetes. This is the first evidence that probiotics play a role in maintaining the body's levels of the bone-strengthening vitamin. A variety of factors may reduce Vitamin D absorption, including limited exposure to sunlight, dark skin, obesity, and problems with absorption or ability to convert Vitamin D to its active form. 'This study is adding to the body of knowledge on the microbiome (the community of bacteria in the gut) and its role in human health,' said Dr. Jones, lead study author and chief scientific officer at probiotic company Micropharma Limited. 'Although it has long been known that the gastrointestinal tract plays an active role in the absorption of Vitamin D, these findings showing improved Vitamin D status in response to an orally delivered probiotic are a first, and will inform the development of new products that may be beneficial for people with low Vitamin D levels.' The study was published in the Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism.

Pelbagai faktor boleh mengurangkan penyerapan Vitamin D, termasuk pendedahan terhad terhadap cahaya matahari, kulit gelap, obesiti, dan masalah dengan penyerapan atau keupayaan untuk menukar Vitamin D kepada bentuk aktifnya. 'Kajian ini menambah kepada pengetahuan tentang mikrobiom (komuniti bakteria dalam usus) dan peranannya dalam kesihatan manusia,' kata Dr. Jones, penulis kajian utama dan ketua pegawai saintifik di syarikat probiotik Micropharma Limited. Kajian itu diterbitkan dalam Jurnal Endokrinologi & Metabolisme Klinikal.

article_content: From the outside, the Dolphin Hotel in Sydney's Surry Hills displayed a sign apologizing to patrons for being closed due to the public holiday on Monday. Inside, however, the atmosphere was entirely different. The South Sydney Rabbitohs were celebrating their historic NRL premiership victory from the previous night against the Canterbury Bulldogs—their first win in 43 years. The only hint of the festivities inside was a bright red and green South Sydney Rabbitohs flag hanging from the hotel's balcony. Team captain John Sutton and star player Greg Inglis, whose long-range try nicknamed the 'goanna crawl' had spectators cheering on Sunday night, were spotted relaxing on the balcony. Inglis, with a cigarette dangling from his lips and a backwards hat, looked content after a long day of celebrating. Tom Burgess also made a brief appearance, as hotel staff struggled against the wind to tape tablecloths to the glass for privacy. Earlier in the day, the team received a heroic welcome from thousands of fans who gathered at Redfern Oval to celebrate the club's long-awaited grand final win. Sam Burgess, despite playing most of Sunday's game with a broken cheek, was present and enthusiastic. He postponed surgery to continue celebrating with his teammates, with CEO Shane Richardson calling him 'the bravest man I've ever seen'. For Souths legend George Piggins, who fought to reinstate the club after its expulsion in 2000, Sunday's game was his first attendance since Russell Crowe and Peter Holmes à Court took over in 2006. Piggins praised the team's courage but highlighted John Sattler, who played almost the entire 1970 grand final with a broken jaw. Thousands of fans turned up to congratulate the Rabbitohs on their first premiership in 43 years. The streets around Redfern Oval were filled with red and green, and chants of 'South Sydney' echoed through the air. About 10,000 fans were expected to attend the celebrations, with lines snaking halfway around the block.

article_content: Corey Haim, a beloved 1980s teen icon, seemed to be overcoming his drug addiction in the weeks leading up to his untimely death, according to his manager and close friend. The actor, known for his charming roles, passed away early Wednesday after collapsing in his Los Angeles apartment, which he shared with his mother. Haim had been gradually reducing his medication under the guidance of an addiction specialist, as stated by his manager, Mark Heaslip, during an interview on HLN's 'Issues With Jane Velez-Mitchell.' His longtime friend and frequent co-star, Corey Feldman, mentioned on CNN's 'Larry King Live' that Haim was started on a new set of medications. Feldman urged the public not to jump to conclusions about the cause of Haim's death, emphasizing that the autopsy results are pending. He noted that Haim's symptoms could indicate various health issues, such as kidney or heart failure. Heaslip mentioned that Haim's mother, Judy, saw no signs of an overdose. Haim's career was on the rise, with multiple film projects lined up, including one set for release soon. Feldman highlighted Haim's personal growth, particularly his support for his mother during her cancer battle. Haim was pronounced dead at Providence St. Joseph Medical Center in Burbank, California, after becoming unresponsive at home. Authorities found no illicit drugs but recovered four prescription medications. An autopsy, including toxicology tests, will be conducted to determine the cause of death. Feldman expressed frustration over the entertainment industry's treatment of Haim, noting his financial struggles despite his past fame. Haim's most famous role was in the 1987 film 'The Lost Boys,' where he starred alongside Feldman. article_content: Discussing your hobbies in job interviews holds more weight than you might think. When aiming to impress an interviewer, your instinct might be to stick to professional topics. However, you'll likely be asked about your hobbies or interests, and your response can be more impactful than you realize. There are effective ways to answer this question and pitfalls to avoid. Planning your response is wise, especially given the competitive and stressful job market. According to a Monster poll, 77% of job seekers experience stress, 69% face mental struggles, and 12% deal with physical side effects like anxiety and exhaustion. Preparing thoughtful answers can reduce anxiety and boost your chances of a positive experience. A well-planned response can enhance your likelihood of securing a job that fits you well. Being authentic allows interviewers to assess your suitability for the role and the company culture. Therefore, being intentional about every part of the job search, including how you discuss your hobbies, is crucial. When talking about your hobbies, highlight your skills and passions. Interviewers often ask about your interests to learn more about you or to lighten the interview mood. Your response can reveal your personality, skills, thinking style, and confidence, contributing to the overall impression you make. Here are tips for discussing your hobbies effectively: 1. Show Your Passion for the Role: Relate your hobbies to the job you're seeking. For example, if you're applying for a teaching position, mention volunteering at a library to read to children, demonstrating your passion for kids. If you're aiming for an interior design job, talk about your home improvement projects, showcasing your creativity. Explain the 'why' behind your activities to make a stronger impression. 2. Highlight Key Skills: Use your hobbies to showcase relevant skills. For instance, if you're an engineer, mention participating in a pinewood derby, highlighting your problem-solving skills. If you're a landscape designer, talk about working in nurseries, demonstrating your plant knowledge. Emphasizing your skills through various examples can set you apart. 3. Show Community Mindedness: Connect your hobbies to community involvement. Instead of just reading, mention helping an elderly neighbor or volunteering at a food pantry, showcasing your interpersonal skills and community spirit. 4. Demonstrate Growth and Initiative: Discuss how your hobbies have helped you grow. For example, joining a Toastmasters club to improve public speaking or starting a reading club at your previous job shows your initiative and commitment to learning. 5. Showcase Wellbeing: Explain how your hobbies help you manage stress. For instance, walking your dog daily or knitting can show your self-awareness and resilience. Overall, being open and authentic about your hobbies can help you secure a job that aligns with your passions.
translated_content: Membincangkan hobi anda dalam temu bual kerja mempunyai kesan yang lebih besar daripada yang anda fikirkan. Apabila anda berusaha untuk mengagumkan penemu bual, insting anda mungkin hanya untuk bercakap tentang topik profesional. Namun, anda mungkin ditanya tentang hobi atau minat anda, dan jawapan anda boleh memberi kesan yang lebih besar daripada yang anda sedari. Ada cara yang berkesan untuk menjawab soalan ini dan perkara yang perlu dielakkan. Merancang jawapan anda adalah bijak, terutama mengingat pasaran kerja yang kompetitif dan menegangkan. Menurut tinjauan Monster, 77% pencari kerja mengalami tekanan, 69% menghadapi masalah mental, dan 12% mengalami kesan fizikal seperti kebimbangan dan keletihan. Menyediakan jawapan yang teliti boleh mengurangkan tekanan dan meningkatkan peluang anda untuk pengalaman yang positif. Jawapan yang dirancang baik boleh meningkatkan peluang anda untuk mendapatkan pekerjaan yang sesuai dengan anda. Keaslian membolehkan penemu bual menilai kesesuaian anda untuk peranan dan budaya syarikat. Oleh itu, bersikap tegas dalam setiap aspek pencarian kerja, termasuk cara anda membincangkan hobi anda, adalah penting. Apabila anda membincangkan hobi anda, soroti kemahiran dan minat anda. Penemu bual sering bertanya tentang minat anda untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut tentang anda atau untuk meringankan suasana temu bual. Jawapan anda boleh mendedahkan personaliti, kemahiran, gaya berfikir, dan keyakinan anda, yang semuanya menyumbang kepada kesan keseluruhan yang anda buat. Berikut adalah tip untuk membincangkan hobi anda dengan berkesan: 1. Tunjukkan Minat Anda untuk Peranan: Hubungkan hobi anda dengan pekerjaan yang anda cari. Contohnya, jika anda memohon jawatan pengajar, sebut tentang sukarelawan di perpustakaan untuk membaca kepada kanak-kanak, menunjukkan minat anda terhadap kanak-kanak. Jika anda bertujuan untuk pekerjaan reka bentuk dalaman, bercakap tentang projek peningkatan rumah anda, menunjukkan kreativiti anda. Jelaskan 'mengapa' di sebalik aktiviti anda untuk memberi kesan yang lebih kuat. 2. Soroti Kemahiran Utama: Gunakan hobi anda untuk menonjolkan kemahiran yang relevan. Misalnya, jika anda jurutera, sebut tentang mengambil bahagian dalam derby kayu pinus, menonjolkan kemahiran penyelesaian masalah anda. Jika anda pereka landskap, bercakap tentang bekerja di nurseri, menunjukkan pengetahuan anda tentang tumbuhan. Menekankan kemahiran anda melalui pelbagai contoh boleh membezakan anda. 3. Tunjukkan Kesedaran Komuniti: Sambungkan hobi anda dengan libatannya dalam komuniti. Sebaliknya hanya membaca, sebut tentang membantu jiran tua atau sukarelawan di pusat makanan, menunjukkan kemahiran antara manusia dan semangat komuniti anda. 4. Tunjukkan Pertumbuhan dan Inisiatif: Bincangkan bagaimana hobi anda telah membantu anda berkembang. Contohnya, menyertai kelab Toastmasters untuk meningkatkan kemahiran bercakap awam atau memulakan kelab membaca di tempat kerja sebelumnya menunjukkan inisiatif dan komitmen anda untuk belajar. 5. Tunjukkan Kesejahteraan: Jelaskan bagaimana hobi anda membantu anda mengurus tekanan. Misalnya, berjalan dengan anjing anda setiap hari atau menenun boleh menunjukkan kesedaran diri dan daya tahan anda. Secara keseluruhan, jadi terbuka dan autentik tentang hobi anda boleh membantu anda mendapatkan pekerjaan yang sejajar dengan minat anda.

article_content: As night descends on Damascus, most residents retreat to their homes in fear. However, a few brave souls venture out, seeking to drown the thunder of artillery with the beat of dance music. Despite shells raining down on suspected rebel positions just miles away, these determined revelers head to the capital's nightclubs to escape the war's grim reality. 'Change of atmosphere': Young people dance at a nightclub in downtown Damascus, a city torn apart by a 30-month civil war that has claimed over 100,000 lives. 'Raving, I'm raving': Young men in Western attire raise their hands as a pulsating track blasts through the club's speakers, momentarily silencing the sound of distant artillery. 'I come here for a change of atmosphere,' says Mohammad, a 25-year-old car salesman, clearly enjoying his drinks. 'There is joy here,' he remarks about the nightclub in the upscale Shaalan neighborhood, where the bartender deftly juggles bottles of spirits. 'I want to live, I don't want to hear any more bad news.'

'Perubahan suasana': Orang muda menari di kelab malam di pusat bandar Damascus, sebuah bandar yang terkoyak oleh perang saudara 30 bulan yang telah meragut lebih 100,000 nyawa. 'Saya datang ke sini untuk perubahan suasana,' kata Mohammad, seorang penjual kereta berusia 25 tahun, jelas menikmati minumannya.
